messages:
Zoe L: Heads-up: partner team wants a final routing rule for SI co-sell when the deal involves HW pre-install + marketplace listing. we need clear handoff and notification pattern before next vendor call.
Marcus C: Short answer: prefer single owner. Priority order: AE CRM owner -> SI with active engagement tag -> marketplace ops. must include recent-contact guard and ACV threshold.
Ivy N: propose concrete thresholds: named account & ACV >= 75k -> assign SI_claim. named & ACV < 75k -> notify AE + add to partner_queue. discovery/opps -> marketplace_queue.
Omar H: add HW-cert requirement: if opportunity has hw_onprem_required tag, block auto-assign to SI until hw-validation flag cleared. route to hw-validation channel and set TTL 96h.
si-broker-bot: Automated claim created: "Veridian Labs" -> partner_queue. claim_id=CLM-3210. Notified: @MarcusC @ZoeL :robot_face:
Zoe L: good. who should get the DM? marketplace-bot should DM the AE if CRM owner exists, otherwise public post to #partnerships + @si-broker. include claim link and ACV.
Marcus C: overlap guard: if AE/SE has outreach within last 12 days, prefer AE and annotate claim with "recent-contact". also include a quick conflict resolver: if 2+ SIs request claim, open a 36h broker window and use simple scoring (relationship, response_time, capacity).
Ivy N: scoring sketch: relationship*3 + response_speed*2 + hw_cert_experience*1. ops will log scores in claim metadata. no exclusivity unless legal flagged.
legal-bot: FYI: any exclusivity request must route to legal-review and require signed addendum. will auto-create LR ticket when exclusivity=true. :page_with_curl:
Omar H: can we add a notification SLA: 48h for claim acceptance, auto-escalate to partner-leads after SLA. and 72h runway for hw-validation hold.
Zoe L: please capture a 1-pager for vendor call: routing order, ACV thresholds, hw-validation hold, overlap logic, brokerage scoring, SLAs, and sample DM/email snippets. Marcus/Ivy please collate by EOD.
Marcus C: on it. will include sample CRM mapping rules and a tiny state diagram.
Ivy N: i'll add the scoring weights and a couple of example scenarios (multi-SI, HW block, AE recent-contact).
Zoe L: thanks all  we'll run a 5-account pilot next week to validate flow. :rocket:
